in_sanskrit.name: Aparajitaa
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who cannot be conquered or defeated

in_marathi.name: Aparajitaa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aparajitaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। She who cannot be conquered or defeated. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'apara' meaning beyond and 'jita' meaning victory. Aparajitaa is a symbol of courage, strength, and determination.
